title: Intern Logbook
description:
A web-based internship logbook system designed to help students document and share daily activities efficiently.

Features a page-flipping preview interface and shareable links for easy supervisor access, improving documentation workflow and user experience.

title: Telegram Bot for Prayer Times
description:
A Telegram bot that provides accurate daily prayer times for users in Malaysia.

Integrates with the JAKIM e-Solat API to deliver real-time updates, allowing users to conveniently check prayer times directly within Telegram.

title: Mosque Mobile App
description:
A mobile application developed for mosque members to stay connected with community activities and prayer schedules.

Includes prayer time reminders, announcements, and news updates to enhance communication and engagement within the mosque.

title: Sudoku Web Game
description:
An interactive web-based Sudoku game supporting both solo and multiplayer gameplay.

Features real-time interaction and an intuitive interface, demonstrating game logic implementation and dynamic front-end development.

title: Chocolicious
description:
A web-based platform for browsing and ordering chocolate products through a clean and user-friendly interface.

Includes product listings, detailed views, and a streamlined ordering process with a focus on responsive design.

title: Personal Expense Tracker
description:
A mobile application that helps users track and manage daily expenses efficiently.

Enables transaction recording and monthly spending monitoring, promoting better financial awareness through a simple and intuitive interface.
